summary: Iteration 8 frontend-only validation of the redesigned Lily video-call stage in ChatWidget. All 11 requested UI acceptance criteria pass. Lily stage renders with big 140px avatar, subtitle bubble with Chinese greeting, 4 always-visible fixed option buttons, chat-input at bottom, handoff/tts/history controls in top bar, and correctly hides when admin toggles lily_enabled:false (falls back to queue-view).

test_results.lily_subtitle_greeting: PASS — contains '您好' and '欢迎' (Lily opening line auto-loaded via /api/lily/open)
test_results.lily_options_4_fixed: PASS — query_recharge, query_withdrawal, view_promotions, query_ticket all visible
test_results.lily_option_query_recharge_click: PASS — POST /api/lily/reply?text=查询充值状态 fired; subtitle updated to new Lily response
test_results.chat_input_present: PASS — [data-testid=chat-input] present at bottom of stage
test_results.lily_handoff_btn: PASS — click hides lily-stage and shows queue-view
test_results.lily_tts_toggle: PASS — toggled 3x, no crash, stage remains
test_results.lily_disabled_fallback: PASS — after PATCH /api/admin/settings {lily_enabled:false}, refresh -> lily-stage NOT rendered, queue-view shown

critical_code_review_comments: ChatWidget.jsx is ~824 lines — approaching maintainability limit; consider splitting Lily stage into a separate component (LilyStage.jsx) in a future refactor.

Duplicate [data-testid=lily-options] and [data-testid=lily-option-*] blocks exist in both the Lily stage (line ~597) AND the human-agent branch (line ~717) — the second is unreachable (lilyMode is false in that branch). Dead code; remove the lines 717-737 block.
chooseLilyOption uses a setTimeout with setText(oldText) hack (line 320-343) to send option label — brittle. Could refactor to call sendMessage(userText) directly.
Lily reply is fetched via query-string POST (text in URL) — fine for now but should move to JSON body for consistency with REST conventions.
seed_data_creation: None; used ephemeral prechat sessions with unique timestamped emails to avoid rate limit.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-8 visual redesign validated. Backend Lily endpoints unchanged from iter-7 (already 12/12 pass in test_iter7_lily.py). If retesting, purge db.sessions where creator_ip='127.0.0.1' to avoid prechat 429 rate limit. Restored lily_enabled=true at end of test.
